feed.title: The Omics Hub Tutorials
feed.subtitle: Reproducible bioinformatics, Linux HPC, workflow automation, single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, and cancer genomics tutorials.

entry.title: scRNA-seq Basics: QC, Normalization, and Clustering
entry.summary: Work through public PBMC 3k single-cell QC thresholds, normalization, PCA elbow selection, and UMAP clustering in parallel R Seurat and Python Scanpy tracks.

entry.title: scRNA-seq Integration QC: LISI and Silhouette
entry.summary: Evaluate single-cell integration with iLISI, cLISI, and silhouette width while avoiding confounded batch comparisons and cell-count artifacts.

entry.title: Choosing and Checking Cell-Type Annotations
entry.summary: Compare marker-based and reference-based single-cell annotation methods on PBMC benchmarks with sensitivity and tissue-context checks.

entry.title: scRNA-seq Integration: Harmony, RPCA, and CCA
entry.summary: Decide when batch correction is justified across single-cell replicates and compare Harmony and Seurat integration outputs on PBMC data.

entry.title: Downstream scRNA-seq Analysis Decision Guide
entry.summary: Select post-clustering analyses across pseudobulk differential expression, composition shifts, cell-cell signaling, regulons, and multimodal embeddings.

entry.title: Donor-Aware Pseudobulk Differential Expression with DESeq2
entry.summary: Aggregate single-cell counts to sample-level pseudobulk profiles, fit DESeq2 models on independent donors, and check diagnostics and FDR calibration.

entry.title: Spatial Transcriptomics in R and Python: Visium
entry.summary: Inspect Visium capture spots alongside histology coordinates, filter low-count spots, normalize spatial features, and interpret regional gene domains.

entry.title: CITE-seq Weighted Nearest Neighbor (WNN) Multi-Omics
entry.summary: Preprocess matched scRNA-seq and surface ADT count matrices in Seurat, compute per-cell WNN modality weights, and refine immune cell states.

entry.title: inferCNV Copy Number Variation Detection in scRNA-seq
entry.summary: Detect large-scale chromosomal copy-number gains and losses from ordered single-cell expression relative to diploid reference populations.

entry.title: Whole Exome Sequencing (WES): Variant Calling
entry.summary: Align paired exome reads, run GATK variant calling and hard filtering, perform build liftover, and inspect VAF vs read-depth QC metrics.

entry.title: Reproducible Workflows: Snakemake and Nextflow
entry.summary: Structure bioinformatics pipelines as declarative DAGs in Snakemake and Nextflow with isolated environments, sample sheets, and resume support.

entry.title: Writing Slurm Job Scripts
entry.summary: Write and verify Slurm batch submission scripts for HPC clusters, configure logs and task arrays, and inspect final scheduler accounting.

entry.title: Basic Slurm Commands
entry.summary: Inspect cluster modules and partitions, run R or Python batch smoke scripts, parse sacct accounting rows, and check MaxRSS memory use.
